notes: v638 — the three ready-made rule sets (🛡 Defender, ⚖ All-rounder, ⚡ Hunter) now use evidence-backed numbers from an extensive backtest session, not the original estimates. All three keep the same profit-target / stop-loss shape but drop the trailing stop, break-even, and time-limit rules entirely — testing showed a plain target/stop beat the more complex exit on identical entries. If you're already running one of these three presets, nothing changes automatically — open 📐 My Rules and tap the preset again to pick up the new numbers, then 💾 Save. A custom mix you've saved yourself is untouched. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
